summary: Deployment objectives often specify desired outcomes without providing revised trajectories, while parts of the original reference must still be followed. We present OneSteer, a one-step diffusion whole-body controller that combines general motion tracking with selective test-time steering.
takeaways: For nominal tracking, the model trained from scratch achieves the lowest local tracking error among the evaluated baselines on successful held-out AMASS and BONES clips.
We present OneSteer, a one-step diffusion whole-body controller that combines general motion tracking with selective test-time steering.
Beyond control, prediction variation in the model trained from scratch ranks likely tracking failures without physics rollouts.
